text: Phone test (2 min): on the demo board http://exon-pc.tailf59262.ts.net:7810/ press A on 'Approve the plan', wait 30 s, then Dismiss one; tell the PM what you saw
context:
Why your phone's answer presses never recorded (shiny-monkey-mo72). A demo board (sample data only, every action takes 11 s on purpose, logs each press):
http://exon-pc.tailf59262.ts.net:7810/
On the same phone, browser and network as when it failed:
1. Open the URL, tap Requests.
2. Tap "Approve the plan: 3 strands, A to C", press A.
3. Don't reload; wait 30 s; note or screenshot the line under the buttons.
4. Press Dismiss on any other request; wait 30 s again.
5. Tell the PM: phone OS and browser; browser tab, home-screen icon or in-app browser; other board tabs open?; did a red line appear at the top of the Questions panel on the live board?
